source: Destatis GV100-derived municipality register (2022), reconciled with Statistik Nord official changes through 2026-01-01
reconciliation_notes: The 1,104 municipality rows are keyed by eight-digit Amtlicher Gemeindeschlüssel (AGS) and reconciled against official administrative changes effective through 2026-01-01.

A 2026 state-government overview reports 1,106 municipalities while Statistik Nord's 2023 area data reports 1,104. The catalogue count is the number of unique municipality AGS rows after the listed mergers, not a hard-coded headline count; recheck the official current directory before the next annual refresh.
Administrative changes with a future effective date (including the Sylt change scheduled for 2027-01-01) are not applied before their effective date.
District/locality names such as Garstedt are aliases of their municipality, not separate municipalities; the current alias seed maps Garstedt to Norderstedt (AGS 01060063).
